situation.original_eligibility_rule: at least 128 untruncated tokens under the 1.5B tokenizer
situation.role_key_rule: SHA-256(UTF8(seed) || NUL || UTF8(row_id) || NUL || ASCII(raw_text_sha256) || NUL || ASCII(token_ids_sha256))
situation.why_retokenisation_is_needed: authority 4.3 reuses this corpus for its raw text rows and its frozen role assignment, but the token ids were produced by a different tokenizer than the model P-2 fits on

rule.1_retokenise: every row is retokenised with the 7B target tokenizer at revision 916b56a44061fd5cd7d6a8fb632557ed4f724f60, carrying forward force_bos = True exactly as the corpus manifest records it
rule.2_assert: each row must still yield at least 128 untruncated tokens
rule.3_discard: a row that fails is discarded, and recorded individually with row_id, its 1.5B token count and its 7B token count
rule.4_never_backfill: no new row may be drawn from the candidate pool to replace a discarded one
rule.5_roles_preserved: surviving rows keep their frozen role assignment exactly; no row is reassigned
rule.6_hashes: both token-id hashes are committed, the original 1.5B and the newly computed 7B, together with surviving counts per role

why_backfilling_is_forbidden.statement: Drawing a replacement row from the candidate pool would let the 7B tokenizer participate in a selection that was frozen before it was involved.
why_backfilling_is_forbidden.consequence_if_allowed: the surviving corpus would no longer be a subset of the pre-registered corpus; it would be a new corpus selected partly by a property of the model under study
why_backfilling_is_forbidden.cost_of_the_rule: the effective sample size can only shrink, never be topped back up. That cost is accepted deliberately, because a smaller pre-registered sample is worth more than a full sample with a contaminated selection rule.

stop_condition.rule: if surviving rows in role A or role B fall below 400, stop and report
stop_condition.basis: roughly four times the published saturation point of about 100 sequences, so it retains a substantial margin

expected_direction.prediction_recorded_before_measuring: most rows should survive, because the two tokenizers are close relatives with nearly identical vocabulary sizes, 151936 against 152064, and a row at the 128-token margin under one is likely near it under the other
expected_direction.why_record_a_prediction: so that a large unexpected loss is visibly surprising rather than quietly accepted

claim_ceiling: This is a data-preparation rule. It licenses no claim of any kind.
